quotes.text: pers8. ¿Qué relación de parentesco tiene [Nombre de persona] con [Nombre de proveedora principal]?
hog2 De las personas que residen habitualmente en esta vivienda, ¿todas comparten los gastos para alimentación?
hog3 Entonces, contando el de usted: ¿cuántos grupos tienen gastos separados para alimentación?
3 Por responsabilidades familiares permanentes (cuidado de niños o personas dependientes)

assessments.reasoning: 1. member_to_member_relationships: False. Question pers8 records relationship solely relative to the main provider (proveedora principal), rather than using a full matrix or member-to-member pointer variables. 2. extended_ties: True. Question pers8 includes categories beyond spouse and parent-child, such as siblings (Hermano/a), grandparents/grandchildren (Abuelo/a, Nieto/a), in-laws, and non-kin (No pariente). 3. multiple_household_criteria: True. Questions hog2 and hog3 explicitly define sharing food expenses (gastos para alimentación) as the criterion to separate households within a dwelling. 4. sub_units: False. The instrument records individual relationships relative to the main provider and provides no method or variables to group members into secondary family units or nuclei. 5. caregiving_relationships: False. Although j7 includes care of dependents as a reason for not seeking work, the survey does not record who cares for whom inside or across households.
